ideas.pitch: A multilingual, multi-modal campus compliance and accessibility tracker tailored for colleges, allowing non-CS and commerce students to audit infrastructural and administrative accessibility.
ideas.title: InclusiveCampus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted at a hackathon that explicitly welcomes non-engineering and arts/humanities backgrounds, appealing to holistic campus inclusivity.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered peer tutoring and micro-credential matching network designed for high school and first-time hackathon participants to bridge academic silos.
ideas.title: SkillBridge AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the beginner-friendly focus of the hackathon by empowering freshers and school students to find study partners and skill mentors instantly.

ideas.pitch: Regional nutrition tracking and budget-friendly meal planner optimized for local ingredients and campus canteens, built with an intuitive UI for non-technical majors.
ideas.title: NutriLocal Jammu
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning formula of consumer wellness apps like E-Foodiee, but customized for local student demographics and budget constraints.

ideas.pitch: Low-bandwidth agricultural advisory dashboard for rural students and farming families to diagnose crop health issues using simple smartphone photos.
ideas.title: AgriSathi AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-impact social utility with a lightweight mobile-first interface suited for 48-hour delivery by multidisciplinary student teams.

ideas.pitch: Transparent micro-grant tracking and expense management tool for student clubs and inter-college event organizers to manage budgets without complex accounting software.
ideas.title: FundFlow Lite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to commerce, BBA, and MBA students participating in the hackathon by solving a real administrative pain point in colleges.
